title: Line Up the Rank
setup: Your e-pawn reaches the eighth rank next move, and the black king and rook already stand on it.
hint: King and rook share a line with the square your pawn is heading for. Which of the two is in front?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{e8=Q+}} promotes with check along the eighth rank, so Black gets no time to stop the pawn. The rook on a8 stands behind the king on that same line: step to c7 and the new queen takes it. {{Ka7}} or {{Kb7}} keeps the rook guarded, but you are still a queen against a rook.

When the enemy king stands on your queening rank, promote with check.
